items.prompt: Does LEFT JOIN alone guarantee exactly one output row per left trade?

options.text: No; repeated right keys can multiply matches
options.why: It preserves unmatched left rows but does not enforce right uniqueness.

options.text: Yes; it automatically chooses one arbitrary metadata row
options.why: No such one-match rule is implied.

options.text: Yes; it discards every repeated business event
No; it always drops every unmatched left row
options.why: That describes inner-join loss, not left-join preservation.

items.explanation: A left join retains left rows without matches, but a right side with several matches still yields several joined rows.
